scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it's been approved, denied, or if it's still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a conventional loan for cash-out refinancing has been denied. The only reason listed for the denial is your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you explain what my debt-to-income ratio means for my application? Also, are there any other reasons listed for the denial besides the debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent:
Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. Lenders use this to assess your ability to manage monthly payments. In your case, your DTI was between 50% and 60%, which contributed to the denial of your application.

No, there are no other reasons listed for the denial besides your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I understand. Can you tell me what my interest rate and the total costs of the loan would have been if my application had been approved? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent:
The record does not include information on the interest rate or total loan costs because the application was denied.

This field is not applicable because the loan was denied, so it has not been transferred or sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have a few more questions. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, what is my loan term?
dialogue.agent: There are no high-cost (HOEPA) flags or negative amortization features on your loan. Your loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user:
Got it. Thank you for your help. I think that's all the questions I have for now.

<Dissatisfied>

Reason: I'm a bit disappointed that my application was denied, but I appreciate the clear explanation about the debt-to-income ratio. However, I wish I had more information about the interest rate and total costs to understand what I might have been approved for.
